text:
nora: idea: new office ritual — The Thermos Throne. whoever arrives with the warmest thermos gets the ceremonial spoon (Sir Stir-a-lot) and a sash. low effort, maximal pomp.

ben: ooh sash material? i'm lobbying for felt. also can we embroider job titles on it? Senior Snack Officer has a nice ring. :laughing: :tea:

sam: rule proposal: thermos must be at least 60C on arrival (spoiler: ben's thermos never is). also, sash must be returned before lunch unless you're on monarch duties.

ops-bot: Quick poll created: "Thermos Throne inaugural holder?" Options: nora, ben, julia, sam

julia: i'm in if crown includes a tiny flag with a doodle. i'll volunteer weekly doodles.

plant-bot: fernus sends photosynthesized regards and will accept ceremonial soil kisses. :seedling: @nora please advise regarding regalia near greenery.

ben: fernus for president. can we add a leaf to the sash for botanical representation?

nora: only human monarchs may operate the kettle. plants get honorary titles and bragging rights.

sam: enforcement mechanism: the monarch wears the sash when making coffee runs and gets to pick the music for the kitchen (5 minutes max).

ops-bot: Poll results: nora 1, ben 1, julia 1, sam 0, abstain 2

ben: great, perfect three-way tie, as expected. time for ancient conflict resolution technique: name that snack. loser brings snacks, winner picks playlist.

julia: challenge accepted. i'm bringing my A-game.

sam: can we formalize a Traditions folder in the wiki? i'll draft a one-paragraph constitution for ceremonial thermoses. minimal legalese.

nora: love it. constitution should include: ceremony schedule, sash care, Sir Stir-a-lot custody rules, and a clause prohibiting spicy soups in the thermos while on throne duties.

ben: spicy soups are a human right. we can add a temp waiver form. fill out on paper, sign with a coffee stain.

ops-bot: Tie-breaker method proposed: "name that snack" at 9:55. Loser supplies snacks and wears the sash during handoff.

julia: placing my doodle deposit. also, note: thermos checks will be carried out with a non-invasive forehead thermometer glance.

sam: formal objection to forehead thermometers. too medieval. i propose the Spoon-Heat-Scale: quick tap and judge by jingle.

ben: spoon jingle accepted. long live the Thermos Throne. may the warmest beverage reign. :crown:
